description: Use before paying for POST /v1/verify/document: send the same body, and get back the quote and link pairs it would check, what was skipped and why, the number of parts and the exact price. Nothing is fetched, signed or charged. Free. Free. Docs: https://vehcdj664efetfrsolne5umanq.srv.us/docs/verify-document

examples.document:
WHO says "Air pollution kills an estimated seven million people every year" ([WHO](https://www.who.int/health-topics/air-pollution)).

> These domains may be used as illustrative examples in documents
> — [IANA](https://www.iana.org/help/example-domains)

case_sensitive.description: Default false; must be false with match "passages".

document.description: The answer or report as written, 1 character to 60000 bytes (UTF-8). Its quotes and their links are found by fixed rules (extractor doc-v1).

format.description: markdown (default), text (only bare URLs and [n] references are links) or html (<a href> links, <blockquote> and <q> quotes; other tags are dropped).

match.description: For every pair: exact; fuzzy (default), which also accepts small differences; or passages, for a paraphrased claim: the 3 passages that share most of its words, scored, as evidence for you to judge (not a verdict). With "passages", each sentence that carries a link is a claim.

min_words.description: A quoted span with fewer words is skipped as too_short (default 4).

part.description: 0-based part to check, default 0; call POST /v1/verify/document/preview first to see how many parts there are.

part_size.description: Pairs per part, default 10. A free trial call needs 3 or fewer.

name: attestpage_preview_document

document_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the document as sent (UTF-8); the paid route signs the same value.

pairs.description: Each pair: pair, part, quote, url, doc_start/doc_end (code points in the document); doc_spans when the pair appears more than once (the first 20), with doc_spans_truncated counting the rest.

parts.description: Paid calls needed to check every pair (part 0 to parts - 1).

skipped.description: Each skipped item with its reason: no_url, bad_url, too_short, too_long or beyond_limit. The first 100 only.

skipped_counts.description: Every skipped item counted by reason.

skipped_truncated.description: Skipped items left out of skipped.

title: Preview a document check
